<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailureNotice" name="Payment failure notice" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BackorderDelayNotice" name="Back-order delay notice" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackEmail" name="Feedback email" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_IssueReport" name="Customer issue report" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_IssueReported"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Customer places order">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentResult" name="Payment successful?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockAvailability" name="Items in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer about delay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveBackorder" name="Receive back-order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock available"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick in-stock items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control checks"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" name="Prepare packaging and shipping"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftRequested" name="Gift wrapping requested?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift-wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftMerge" name="Packaging ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageOrder" name="Package order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International" name="International order?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomsMerge" name="Shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin" name="Packaging and documents ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send follow-up email for feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderFulfilled" name="Order fulfillment complete"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Returns process" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IssueReported" name="Customer reports delivery issue" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_IssueReported"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReturnsComplete" name="Returns process complete"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Returns_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IssueReported" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Returns_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Returns_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Returns_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Returns_5" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" targetRef="EndEvent_ReturnsComplete"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_3" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Failed" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentSuccessful = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Successful" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentSuccessful = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailure_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_1" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Available" name="All required items available" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequiredItemsAvailable = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Unavailable" name="Items out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequiredItemsAvailable = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_1" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_2" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_Pick" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_QC" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QC_Split" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Packaging" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_GiftDecision" sourceRef="Task_PackageOrder" targetRef="Gateway_GiftRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gift_Yes" name="Gift wrapping requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftRequested" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">giftWrappingRequested = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gift_No" name="Gift wrapping not requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftRequested" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">giftWrappingRequested = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gift_Wrapped" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Packaging_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_International" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_International"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_Yes" name="International order" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">isInternational = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_No" name="Domestic order" sourceRef="Gateway_International" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">isInternational = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_Ready" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Dispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentJoin" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Inventory" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_Delivery" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderFulfilled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
